Annual Meetings

Morning Session - 2022 Meeting

In the morning session, Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger welcome shareholders to the first in-person meeting since 2019, reveal details about their $40 billion buying spree in March, and complain about index funds telling them Buffett should not be both chairman and CEO of the company.

Mon, May 2 2022 • 12:19 AM EDT
Key Chapters —
  1. 1. When the owners are really old, it's good to see them in person
  2. 7. "We spent 40 billion in a hurry there in three weeks"
  3. 8. Cash is like "oxygen"
  4. 9. How a casual email led to the Alleghany insurance deal
  5. 10. People gambling on stocks made big Occidental stock buys possible
  6. 23. "Berkshire is built for forever. There is no finish point"
  7. 24. "Keep learning"
  8. 25. The "aha" moment for Buffett that changed everything
